findings.text: _concurrency_levels silently skips an empty component, so the malformed input "4,,8" returns [4, 8]. The parser docstring says malformed entries are refused because silently losing a level creates an unmeasured hole, but the parametrized test covers only all-empty input (",,") and misses an interior empty component. Reject blank components or explicitly define this input before relying on the parser as fail-closed. Reproduction: empty-level-reproduction.log.
